s: October 20, 2025 - BlueTriton Brands, Inc. is an American beverage company based in Stamford, Connecticut that is now part of Primo Brands. A former subsidiary of Nestlé, it was known between 2002 and 2021 as Nestlé Waters North America, Inc. and operated as the North American business unit of Nestlé Waters.
Exciting news: BlueTriton Brands has merged with Primo Water!
